seo.title: Meeting agenda
seo.seo_description: Meeting agenda: a WorkStudio starter template for small business. Starting fields, steps, human approval and what to adapt for Quebec before use.

blocks.role: Promesse de la fiche : ce que fait le gabarit « Ordre du jour de réunion », dit sans détour.

translation.headline: Meeting agenda.
translation.subheadline: The Meeting agenda template builds a timed agenda from the topics to cover and the time available: a logical order, time per topic, who presents, the decision expected, and an opening sentence for the meeting, ready to review and circulate.

blocks.role: Réponse d'abord : ce que fait le gabarit, en trois lignes.

translation.title: The short answer.
translation.body:
The Meeting agenda template builds a timed agenda from the topics to cover and the time available: a logical order, time per topic, who presents, the decision expected, and an opening sentence for the meeting, ready to review and circulate.

A workflow template is an automated sequence of tasks, provided as a starting point in WorkStudio and to be adapted to the business before it is deployed.

blocks.role: Les champs de départ du gabarit, tels que déclarés dans WorkStudio.

translation.title: What you provide.
translation.body:
Each starting field is pre-filled with an example value so a first run needs no typing, except email addresses and files.

  • The topics. Topics to cover.
  • The duration. Total time available.

blocks.role: Les étapes du flux : ce que fait chaque agent, où une personne intervient.

cards.title: Build the agenda.
cards.text: An agent proposes a logical order, a time per topic, the presenter and the decision expected, then an opening sentence.

cards.title: Review.
cards.text: You read the text produced, correct it if needed, then use or send it yourself: the template sends nothing.

blocks.role: Ce qui s'adapte avant l'usage : le propre du gabarit, le commun, l'envoi.

cards.title: What to adapt here.
cards.text: The template does not know who presents what in your company: if the information is missing from your topics, check the names before circulating the agenda.

cards.title: What applies to all.
cards.text: The templates are written for a French small business. Taxes, currency, vocabulary and formats are adapted to your business and to Quebec before any use.

cards.title: Nothing is sent.
cards.text: The template produces text to review. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

blocks.role: Questions de la fiche : envoi, point propre au gabarit, adaptation au Québec.

items.question: Does this template send anything for me?
items.answer: No. It produces text to review; you use or send it yourself. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

items.question: Is the agenda sent to the participants?
items.answer: No. The template produces the text; you review it and circulate it yourself.

items.question: Does it suit Quebec as is?
items.answer: Not as is. The starter templates are written for a French small business and do not follow Quebec tax rules: taxes, formats and vocabulary are adapted to your business.

blocks.role: Appel à l'action : démonstration sur données fictives.

translation.title: See it at work.
translation.text: A demonstration on fictional data, to see what the template prepares and where a person stays in control.
